Brand new community chess club in Lexington, Missouri. Welcoming to all from grandmasters to beginners. Kingfisher Chess Club operates in the area. Rules: be respectful, keep language clean and positive.
Meets at Grey Moon Market (Gray Moon Public Market) Thursday nights for casual OTB blitz, bullet, and slow chess. Downtown Newton, about 35 min east of Des Moines.

Box Office Brewery Chess Club in downtown Strasburg, Virginia. Founded by Jeffery Stern and Matt Fusaro. Free, no registration. Chessboards and clocks provided. All levels welcome. Contact: 540-465-2609.

Chess club for enthusiasts in Seaside, Oregon and surrounding areas. All ages and skill levels welcome. Check announcements for casual play, social events, and local tournaments. OSCF hosts state championship at Seaside Civic & Convention Center.

Organizing meet-ups for friendly games in the Raleigh-Durham area. A place to make friends with like-minded progressives. Triangle has Durham Chess Club (Wed at Bull McCabe's) and Raleigh/Durham Meetup at North Street Beer Station.
Westside Chess Club for players from Tigard/Beaverton/West Portland. Meets every Saturday night at Ava Roasteria. All levels welcome.
Casual chess club in Peoria, Illinois. Meets every Sunday at CxT-Campustown Coffee Shop (Campustown Shopping Center, across from Bradley University). All skill levels welcome.
Informal chess meetup for all ages and abilities. Location not specified in available information. Cedar Creek High School in NJ has scholastic chess; may be a different community club.
Blunders and Brews is a social community in the Piedmont Triad area of North Carolina. Good drinks, good company, and chess. Burlington Chess Club meets nearby at Publix Market on Wed/Fri/Sun.

Lower Alabama Chess Club welcomes beginners to seasoned players. Offers casual and competitive play, friendly matches, and tournaments. Alabama Chess Federation serves the state. East Alabama Chess Club meets in Opelika.
Online club for local in-person players in Spotsylvania County, VA. Form required to join - keeps club open to local players to build OTB community. Hosts scholastic and adult events.
Chess club based in Claremont, California. Claremont Colleges (Pomona) has active club that held tournaments in 2024. Reestablished 2022.

Wendell Chess Club at Bearded Bee Brewing. Free, no membership fees. Casual OTB play for all levels. Serves Raleigh, Wendell, Knightdale, Zebulon, Wake Forest. Launched Dec 2025. Contact wendellchessclub@gmail.com.
Social chess club meeting every Monday night at Hildy's Tavern. Grab a beer and play with your local community. Hildy's is a Lancaster dive bar tradition, 717-397-2495.

Iron Horse Chess Association hosts US Chess-rated events in Spring Hill, TN. Tournament Director Jared. From casual match nights to competitive tournaments. Fairness, growth, and community. All levels welcome.
DPAD New Braunfels Chess Club meets every Thursday at 6PM at DPAD (gaming/entertainment retailer). All ages welcome. Fun games of chess.

A new kind of club culture! All levels welcome. Players from 300-2100 have been attending weekly. Location not specified; Tremont may refer to Cleveland neighborhood.

Martinsville library chess club. Morgan County Public Library hosts community programs. Martinsville Artesian Chess Club is scholastic. Check library for chess program schedule.
Casual community promoting over-the-board chess in the shadow of the Tetons. Jackson Hole, Wyoming. Beginners welcome.
Marion County Chess Club - home for players of all ages and skill levels in Central Florida. Meet regularly for friendly games, lessons, and rated tournaments. Welcoming, competitive environment.

Brand-new group of chess enthusiasts in Northeast Tennessee. Building local community, starting to meet in person for casual games and study sessions. East Tennessee Chess Clubs and Kingsport club serve the region.
Portsmouth Chess Club in Southern Ohio. For locals searching for a club to further chess skills and have fun. All ratings welcome.
Chess and Shaolin Kung Fu philosophy club - explores strategy parallels between chess and martial arts. Thematic interest group rather than a physical chess club with regular meetings.

Casual chess for all ages and experience levels in Marshfield, Wisconsin.
Plaza Midwood Chess Club at The Common Market. Casual play, no ratings or formal education. Connecting with like-minded people, community building. Free. Some sets provided. Chess is the excuse!
